name: Meinohama Mai
source:
She is a second year high school student and vice chairman of the Love Support Committee. She is in Yanagawa's class and is very popular. She has a cheerful and absentminded personality, and she is often misunderstood because she treats men and women without barriers. She sometimes scratches the ball because her behavior is strange.

[Translated from [url=https://sonokoi-horyu.net/character/]official website[/url]]
